scientific_integrity: All-parameter formula is analytically proved; exact-rational route clipping checked 85 configurations; symbolic derivative checked. No claim of independent or exhaustive historical certification.
scientific_limitations: Two-pole parallel-edge metric networks with positive lengths and independent arclength-uniform sampling only; the higher-edge infimum is not attained. Doyle–Graver (1982) full text was inaccessible; historical novelty remains provisional. Day-level original-source dating for that 1982 paper was unavailable.
title: A sharp transition in mean-distance minimizers for parallel-path metric networks
